observations: Two black PlayStation consoles are shown side-by-side on a shop counter (photo 0 and photo 1).
The front faces are visible but no clear model/label text (e.g., Pro) is readable from these photos.
No controller is shown in either photo.
No ports/cables/receipt are shown clearly enough to verify claims.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console with one controller Pad
claims.evidence: Photos show PS4 consoles but do not show a controller, and the PS4 Pro model is not readable.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No seals/sticker/inside photos or service history shown.
No temperature/usage test or error logs shown.
No close-up of ports and no functional test shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No controller(s) or receipt shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Exact model may not be PS4 Pro (could be a different PS4 revision), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console rear label/model number (or the PS4 Pro marking) and the box/label if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used PS4 console (worst-case vs Pro).

risks.risk: Controller may be missing, not original, or not working (seller says one controller pad).
risks.proof: Photo of the controller(s) included, plus a short clip showing it pairing and working in-game/menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no working controller).

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty (HDMI/USB/charging), or console may have issues not visible externally.
risks.proof: Video/clip: power on + HDMI display working + test USB ports with a controller + audio output check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume potential port issues.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues or fan problems may exist despite 'no overheating' claim.
risks.proof: Clip showing gameplay for 15–20 minutes with no shutdown + fan noise check (and ideally a temperature reading).

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” cannot be verified; could have been serviced or have replaced parts.
risks.proof: Photo of warranty seals/stickers (if any) and a clear view of the console exterior for tamper indicators.

proof_requests: Clear rear label photo showing model (PS4 Pro vs other) and serial number.
Photo of the included controller(s) and what exactly is included (cables, power lead, etc.).
Short video: power on → home screen loads → controller connects and works.
Video showing HDMI and at least one USB port working (controller + charging/data).
Photo of the UK receipt (or a screenshot) and any warranty/seal indicators.
response.reason: The photos confirm there are PS4 consoles, but they do not clearly verify PS4 Pro model, included controller/receipt, or functional claims (ports/overheating). Without these, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
